name: Red Earth — Gate 2.5 Starter Shiny State + Icons
author: Adam M. Aguilera
description: Gate 2.5 rebuild from the accepted 0.2.4 baseline. Makes only Oak-gift Fennekin and selectable Grass starters genuine shinies, preserves that state through evolution/save flow, and supplies their shiny party/menu icons. Does not alter Irregular art, battle scaling, starter selection, sparkle/audio, Nature, or passives.
